hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for Vietnam. We export motorcycle clutch systems, engine components, three-wheeler parts and aluminium castings.

Vietnam is one of the largest motorcycle markets in Southeast Asia, and bikes fill the streets of Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City every day. Riders need clutch parts that cope with dense traffic and frequent gear changes. Browse our range below. Every component is tested in our plant before dispatch, and our team can help you plan an opening range.

network.title: Why Vietnamese Buyers Source From Us
paras: With more than 25 years of experience in clutch and drivetrain parts, we test every component before dispatch.
Our die casting and CNC capabilities also support component makers who need castings to their own designs.
For component makers, we can produce castings or machined parts to your drawings and deliver them on a planned schedule.

network.title: Shipping Parts to Vietnam
paras: Orders travel by sea in palletised export packing to the Vietnamese port you choose, with complete documents for customs.
Different product lines can share one container, and repeat shipments can be scheduled.
Cartons can be labelled with your part numbers so parts are easy to receive and stock.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the Vietnamese market?
cta.text: Share your part list, models or drawings with quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and send a quotation for delivery to Vietnam. Samples can be arranged before your first volume order, so you can check fit on local models.

faq_intro: Quick answers for importers, distributors and component makers in Vietnam. Our export team replies to enquiries with fitment notes, packing details and clear commercial terms.
faqs: Which motorcycles do your clutch parts suit?
Our clutch parts are made for motorcycles with manual and semi-automatic wet clutches. Share your models to confirm fitment.
Can you supply castings to our drawings?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC lines produce components from drawings or samples after a feasibility review.
Can I combine different parts in one order?
Yes. We combine product lines in one consignment and label cartons by model.
Yes. Samples let you check fit and finish before ordering in volume.

Can you ship on a regular schedule?
Yes. Repeat shipments can be planned so your fast-moving lines stay in stock.
Can you make parts for our assembly line?
Yes. Drawing-based castings and machined parts can be supplied on a planned schedule for production programmes.
